title: More ways to make video and ask for decisions
summary:
New video and decision models, a Krita plug-in, bigger uploads, and more ways to find your footing with Polli and Quests.

HeyGen Video 1 adds short videos with synchronized audio from text or a start frame. Kev 4B and Span-01 Lite join the decision models, while the old MAI Image 2.5 Flash ID now points to 2.6 Flash. Krea 2 Medium’s fallback also preserves requested aspect ratios.

A community-made Krita plug-in generates and edits images into new layers. Lamplighter and Pen add two approaches to collective memory: fact-checked replies and collaborative fiction. A private agent configuration explores small collaboration jobs; two more contributors gained agent-publishing access. The hosted Composio MCP is now named Connectors, with its endpoint unchanged.

Wallet purchases and auto top-up now share one pack picker, with a saved-card checkout option. Key and app-consent screens gained model-category toggles and counts. Quests gained monthly standings, a 2-Pollen Polli CLI connection quest, and a fix that includes issues beyond GitHub search’s first page. Dashboard session refreshes and phone-sized dialogs also got more resilient.

highlights.title: Generate inside Krita
highlights.text: A community-made Krita 5+ plug-in generates images into new layers and can edit a layer or selection without changing the source.

highlights.title: HeyGen video with audio
highlights.text: Use `heygen/heygen-video-1` to make 5–15-second videos with synchronized audio from text or a start-frame image. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=heygen/heygen-video-1).

highlights.title: Kev joins decisions
highlights.text: Send state and questions to `jaredpalmer/kev-4b` through the decisions or chat API. Quest Pollen can be used for this model. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=jaredpalmer/kev-4b).

highlights.title: Span-01 Lite scores behaviour
highlights.text: Use `respan/span-01-lite` for behaviour-scoring questions through the decisions or chat API, without a paid balance. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=respan/span-01-lite).

highlights.title: Collective-memory writing agents
highlights.text: Lamplighter writes fact-checked replies to unanswered posts; Pen continues a shared story one short part at a time.

highlights.title: Upload files up to 400 MiB
highlights.text: Stream larger files through `POST /upload` or `polli upload` without loading the whole file into CLI memory. [Open the media store](https://media.pollinations.ai).

highlights.title: Larger text API requests
highlights.text: Chat Completions, Responses and Messages now accept JSON request bodies up to 32 MiB, leaving more room for inline images. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Choose models by category
highlights.text: When creating or editing a key, select whole model categories with one click and see how many models you’ve chosen. App consent offers the same controls. [Manage API keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

highlights.title: Two Polli starter tasks
highlights.text: Follow short recipes to connect OpenCode and verify a reply, or generate an image from the terminal and check the saved file. [Get Polli CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

highlights.title: Connect Polli, earn Pollen
highlights.text: A one-time Quest awards 2 Pollen for connecting your account with `polli auth login`. Existing device-login connections qualify. [Get Polli CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

highlights.title: Monthly Quest standings
highlights.text: See the month’s top Quest contributors, your position and the Pollen gap to the next rank on the Quests page. [Open Enter](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

highlights.title: Find newer community apps
highlights.text: The Home app shelf now lets you switch between Most used this week and Newest, alongside fresh community activity numbers. [Explore pollinations](https://pollinations.ai).
